2026-11-10 16:57:43.541702 | controller |
2026-11-10 16:57:43.541706 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-11-10 16:57:43.541709 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-11-10 16:57:43.541712 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-11-10 16:57:43.541716 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-11-10 16:57:43.541719 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-11-10 16:57:43.541722 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-11-10 16:57:43.541725 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
